cards.title: What Material Management covers in the ERP
cards.body:
Material Management controls the lifecycle of goods from sourcing to consumption.
It manages vendor requests, quotations, orders, warehouse receipts, and store issues.
The module ensures purchases match authorized demand and that inventory stays accounted for.

cards.title: The core procurement lifecycle from request to receipt
cards.body:
Procurement begins when an internal department raises a formal material request.
Buyers invite vendor prices, evaluate them side by side, and place authorized purchase orders.
Goods arrive at the factory gate and enter warehouse stock through a verified receipt.

cards.title: Quality verification before goods enter usable stock
cards.body:
Material arriving at the gate undergoes inspection before entering usable inventory.
Storekeepers raise inspection intimations to notify quality teams of incoming consignments.
Only accepted quantities increase available stock, while rejected items are isolated.

cards.title: Warehouse storage and material issue to operations
cards.body:
Accepted materials are placed in designated warehouse locations and tracked by bin.
Departments request spares and consumable supplies using authorized internal requests.
Issued stock reduces warehouse balance and charges the expense to the requesting cost center.

cards.title: Four-level material master classification hierarchy
cards.body:
Items are organized under a strict four-level structure to ensure consistent reporting.
Category forms the top level, followed by Group and Sub Group for technical attributes.
The Item represents the individual stocked product linked to its approved suppliers.

cards.title: Where Material Management hands over to Finance
cards.body:
Goods received in stores create valued receipt records that pass to Finance.
The Finance team books supplier purchase bills directly against these receipt records.
Payment requests, payment plans, and vouchers settle vendor balances based on these receipts.

cards.title: Where Material Management hands over to Plant Maintenance
cards.body:
Maintenance teams require engineering spares and equipment parts for preventive work.
Stores issue requested parts against authorized maintenance work orders.
Spares consumption updates maintenance repair costs and decreases warehouse inventory.

cards.title: Vendor master setup governs all procurement activities
cards.body:
Procurement is restricted to approved commercial business partners and verified locations.
Vendor profiles establish valid tax locations, payment currencies, and authorized contacts.
Purchase orders cannot be issued to unapproved suppliers or unmapped locations.
